newsitem.title: USA: Apartment Investment names P. Kompaniez pres.
newsitem.headline: Apartment Investment names P. Kompaniez pres.

text.p: Apartment Investment and Management Co said Friday it named Peter Kompaniez president.
The company was not immediately available to provide information on who he replaced.
In a written statement, the company said Kompaniez will continue with his duties as vice chairman in addition to taking on the responsibilities of president.
Kompaniez is also chief operating officer of NHP Inc and president of NHP Partners entities controlled by Apartment Investments.
As previously announced, the two companies have entered into an agreement providing for the merger of an Apartment Investment subsidiary with NHP.
AIMCO is a real estate investment trust.
